69 channel records; 1 (Wealth Logic) has 0 videos; 24 have no subscriber count; 8 have no sub_niche

170 videos share a normalised title with another channel; 44 (26%) are Breakouts vs 13% overall (hypothesis: cloning of proven titles)

"you" in first ~30s: ratio 1.16 (CI 1.06-1.27), p=0.002 uncorrected, BH q=0.052, positive in 23/43 channels
Title <=60 characters ratio 0.89 (CI 0.80-0.99); enhancer words 0.86 (0.77-0.95); title ending in a question 0.79 (0.69-0.90): all opposite to claimed benefit
Viral Checklist proxy score not positively related to performance (rho -0.035, p 0.056); success rate peaks at 3 boxes
Script-only features give held-out-channel AUC 0.585 (shuffled-label 0.494); all text 0.576; topic-only 0.510
Thumbnail features (face, text amount, brightness, saturation, colourfulness, contrast): none significant after BH except edge density rho 0.054 (q=0.048)
Same title template "If You're Over 60, X Will Give You These N Things": PI ranges 0.15-445 across subjects (Costco 445.6, Aldi 158.9, Airlines 0.17); thumbnail template identical
